#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <map>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n, b;
    cin >> n >> b;
    vector<int> arr(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> arr[i];
    }
    if (n % 2 == 1) {
        cout << 0;
        return 0;
    }
    map<int, int> diff;
    int ec = 0, oc = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (arr[i] % 2 == 0) ec++;
        else oc++;
        if (ec > 0 && oc > 0 && ec == oc) {
            if (i + 1 < n) {
                diff[i] = abs(arr[i] - arr[i + 1]);
            }
        }
    }
    if (diff.empty()) {
        cout << 0;
        return 0;
    } else if (diff.size() == 1) {
        int val = diff.begin()->second;
        if (val <= b) {
            cout << 1;
        } else {
            cout << 0;
        }
        return 0;
    } else {
        vector<int> vals;
        for (auto& p : diff) {
            vals.push_back(p.second);
        }
        sort(vals.begin(), vals.end());
        int k = 0;
        for (int v : vals) {
            if (v <= b) {
                b -= v;
                k++;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        cout << k;
        return 0;
    }
}
